visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a light beige fluffy fleece hoodie is positioned in a close-up shot, leaning over a wooden cutting board. He holds a standard metal kitchen knife and performs a chopping motion on a thick section of dark brown hair spread across the board. The setting is a brightly lit indoor apartment with a patterned black-and-white art piece visible in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where the same man stands next to a woman with long hair. She wears a cream-colored lace-trimmed blouse and grey shorts. They are facing the camera in a modern living room with integrated shelving and a hallway. The man holds the knife while gesturing and talking animatedly. (3) A floating digital video overlay appears, showing a social media clip of a person using a large meat cleaver to cut hair on a board. The main characters watch this together. (4) The woman is then seen lying on her back on the floor, her long hair fanned out across a wooden cutting board. The man leans over her, adjusting her hair and the board while smiling. (5) Close-up shots focus on the man's hands as he uses the kitchen knife to repeatedly strike the wooden board, slicing through the hair fibers. Small pieces of cut hair are visible on the board. (6) After the cut, the woman is seen from behind in a medium shot, revealing her hair which is now shorter but significantly uneven and jagged at the ends. The man’s hand enters the frame to point at the uneven layers. (7) The woman turns to face the mirror and the camera, laughing and displaying the 'artistic' layers of her hair. She uses her hands to frame her head and eventually gives a thumbs-up gesture towards the lens.
